Sandbox_B47_ConstructionHealthPercent_to: Health of newly constructed B47 fence sections and corners, as a percentage of normal health. Default: 100. Range: 10 to 500. Existing fences and nonblocking standalone posts are unchanged. The server setting is authoritative.
Sandbox_B47_WroughtIronCornerPosts_toolt: Add vanilla-style junction posts when newly built B47 wrought-iron sections form a matching perpendicular connection. Included in the section cost. Default: enabled. The server setting is authoritative; disabling it stops new automatic posts and does not remove existing objects.
